title: Tor-amplitude gap forces derived tensor cohomology to vanish
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let P be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] with Tor amplitude in [u,v], meaning that H^i(P\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)=0 for every \mathcal O_X-module \mathcal G and every i\notin[u,v], and let L be a complex with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. For every integer j, if H^q(L)=0 for all q in [j-v,j-u], then H^j(P\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)=0.

source.place: Tag 09M4, proof, spectral sequence after the sentence 'Say K^\vee has tor amplitude in [a,b]'

proof.text: Evaluate lem-pc-kflat-derived-tensor-comparison on constant one-object families. The singleFunctorIsoCompQ and homologyFunctorFactors comparisons turn hTor into the source torAmplitudeIn predicate. The scheme tensor has functorial flat resolutions by def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure.

Set A=tau_{<j-b} L and B=tau_{>=j-b} L. A has cohomology only at degrees at most j-b-1. B is zero below j-b and its cohomology in surviving degrees is that of L, by the long exact homology sequence of the truncation triangle. The gap hypothesis therefore gives B >= j-a+1. This argument needs no interval ordering, including a>b. Integer inequalities are discharged by omega.

Apply lem-sc-source-tor-amplitude-upper-tensor-bound to A: P tensor A <= b+j-b-1=j-1. Apply lem-sc-source-tor-amplitude-lower-tensor-bound to B: P tensor B >= a+j-a+1=j+1. Both degree-j cohomology objects are zero.

Obtain a bounded flat model S of P from lem-sc-source-tor-amplitude-flat-model. It is categorically K-flat by CochainComplex.kFlat_of_bounded_of_flat. Apply lem-sc-source-kflat-tensor-left-triangulated to its homotopy quotient and transport the shift comparison and triangulatedness through its isomorphism to P. Tensor the truncation distinguished triangle. Exactness in degree j and zero outer terms force H^j(P tensor L)=0. The model-dependent shift comparison avoids the upstream global shift instance tying the Grothendieck and derived universes.

Apply hTor to H^0(L) at a-1 to obtain a K-flat representative K of P; its existing witness is used only inside this proposition. Take any quotient preimage N of L. Evaluate lem-pc-kflat-derived-tensor-comparison on K,N, and combine its inverse with the representing isomorphisms. Transport the zero homology through homologyFunctorFactors and package K,N to prove precisely the existing existential tensor vanishing predicate.
